title: Report illegal content
lead: Anyone can report illegal content or an unlawful listing on EventDesk. You do not need an account.
rules: The rules we moderate content by are written in plain Romanian in the <link>moderation rules</link>.

next.title: What happens to your report
next.step1: You receive a report reference at once.
next.step2: A person on our team reviews it. We do not decide automatically.
next.step3: We record the decision and its reason and give them to the affected party. If you leave an email, we also write to you with the outcome.

form.title: Your report
form.targetHint: The page address (link) or the name of the business or listing.
form.descriptionHint: Say briefly what you saw and why you believe it is illegal. At least 10 characters.
form.contactHint: We use it only to tell you the outcome. You can report without it.

done.title: We have received your report.
done.body: Its reference is {reference}. Keep it if you want to follow up on the report.

privacy: We keep your email for at most six months after the decision and never show it to the reported business.

errors.descriptionTooShort: Describe the problem briefly, in at least 10 characters.
